EntityView.name: v snn latest net checkin count
EntityView.userDefinedSQL: select count(qso_start) as 'Checkins' ,date(qso_start,'unixepoch') as 'Net_Date' from v_qso_table_v008 where date(qso_start,'unixepoch') in (select date((select max(qso_start) from v_qso_table_v008),'unixepoch') as 'Latest_Net_Date')
